summary: Frontend-only verification of UnifiedTopbar refactor. Tested guest/student/admin views across 7 pages (/ /learn /announcements /showcase /brand-equity /market-research/conjoint-analysis + login flow). Verified tools dropdown (6 links), admin dropdown (7 links), user avatar dropdown (profile/notifications/dashboard/logout), role badge color, subtitle prop on BeTopbar wrapper, active-state highlighting, logout flow (token cleared → redirect to / → guest topbar restored), no double-topbar regression (.be-topbar:not(.utb-root) returned 0 on all pages), and mobile responsiveness at 390px (hamburger visible, nav hidden, drawer opens). 12/13 test cases passed.

ui_bugs.issue: Student account (student1@swu.ac.th) renders role badge as 'USER' (gray rgb(63,63,70)) instead of the expected 'STUDENT' (blue #1F3A8A). The badge mapping in UnifiedTopbar.jsx (lines 54-60) only outputs 'STUDENT' when user.role === 'student', but the seeded student account appears to have role='user' on the backend. Either (a) update seed/profile so student1's role='student', or (b) extend the mapping to treat role==='user' on a known student email as STUDENT. Not a blocker but the visual contract specified by the review request is not met for the student persona.

verified_acceptance_criteria: UnifiedTopbar renders on all 7 pages tested (data-testid='unified-topbar' present, .be-topbar:not(.utb-root) count = 0).
GUEST view (/, /showcase, /announcements, /learn): utb-login-btn + utb-register-btn visible; utb-tools-dd-trigger, utb-admin-dd-trigger, utb-user-dd-trigger NOT present.
Public nav links utb-nav-{home,learn,announcements,showcase} present on every tested page.
Active state: on /learn, utb-nav-learn has .is-active class and utb-nav-home does not.
STUDENT view (/, /brand-equity): utb-tools-dd-trigger + utb-nav-projects + utb-user-dd-trigger visible; utb-admin-dd-trigger NOT present.

Tools dropdown contains exactly 6 links with correct href + hint code: BE→/brand-equity, CJ→/market-research/conjoint-analysis, CX→/market-research/customer-journey, CB→/market-research/customer-behavior, JF→/market-research/journal-finder, SV→/surveys.
ADMIN view (/, /brand-equity, /market-research/conjoint-analysis): tools + admin + user dropdowns + projects all visible.
Admin dropdown contains exactly 7 links with correct hrefs: /admin/users, /admin/cms, /admin/cms/landing, /admin/cms/prompts, /admin/notifications, /admin/llm-prompts, /admin/settings.
User avatar dropdown contains utb-user-profile, utb-user-notifications, utb-user-dashboard, utb-logout-btn.
Admin role badge background = rgb(200, 16, 46) (= #C8102E red as specified).
Subtitle prop: /brand-equity shows .utb-logo-sub = 'BRAND HEALTH CHECK'; /market-research/conjoint-analysis shows 'CONJOINT ANALYSIS'; / shows no subtitle.
Logout flow: clicking utb-logout-btn navigates to /, utb-login-btn becomes visible again, utb-user-dd-trigger disappears.
Mobile (390px): .utb-hamburger computed display='flex', .utb-nav computed display='none'; clicking hamburger reveals utb-mobile-drawer.
No topbar-related console errors (only 2 unrelated GSI_LOGGER warnings about google.accounts.id.initialize called multiple times — pre-existing, not introduced by this refactor).
action_items: (LOW) Decide on student role badge contract: either set student1@swu.ac.th role='student' in seed data, or broaden the RoleBadge mapping in /app/frontend/src/components/UnifiedTopbar.jsx so non-admin authenticated users display 'STUDENT' instead of 'USER' when expected.
(INFO) Pre-existing duplicate google.accounts.id.initialize() warning is not caused by this refactor but worth deduplicating in a future pass.
critical_code_review_comments: UnifiedTopbar.jsx is clean (~308 lines, single responsibility) and uses data-testid consistently on every interactive element. data-testid='utb-admin-{slug}' is derived from the last path segment (e.g. 'utb-admin-users', 'utb-admin-landing', 'utb-admin-prompts', 'utb-admin-llm-prompts', 'utb-admin-settings') — note this slightly differs from the review-request naming ('utb-admin-cms' vs the resulting 'utb-admin-cms' for /admin/cms but 'utb-admin-landing' for /admin/cms/landing because of split('/').pop()). Not a bug; just a documentation note for future test agents using these IDs.
RoleBadge fallback to USER masks data quality issues — consider logging a warning when an unknown role is encountered so missing seed roles surface in dev.

Dropdown component uses onClick={() => setOpen(false)} on the menu wrapper — this is fine for Link children but means any future non-navigation interactive element placed inside the menu must stopPropagation, otherwise it closes prematurely.
Legacy wrappers (BeTopbar and Topbar) correctly delegate to UnifiedTopbar — confirmed across all 30+ pages by .be-topbar:not(.utb-root) === 0.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (12/13 acceptance criteria fully met; 1 minor badge-label mismatch on student role)

test_credentials: Admin admin@swu.ac.th/admin123 and Student student1@swu.ac.th/student123 both authenticated successfully via /login form.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UnifiedTopbar refactor is solid and stable. All data-testids documented in the review-request are present and behave correctly. If retesting, note that 'utb-admin-{key}' IDs are derived from the last URL segment (utb-admin-users, utb-admin-cms, utb-admin-landing, utb-admin-prompts, utb-admin-notifications, utb-admin-llm-prompts, utb-admin-settings). The only outstanding observation is the STUDENT role badge label which depends on backend user.role value, not on the topbar implementation itself.
rca_of_the_issue: Student badge shows 'USER' because the backend seed/profile for student1@swu.ac.th has user.role !== 'student' (likely 'user'). UnifiedTopbar.jsx RoleBadge maps role.toLowerCase() through a styles dict {admin, teacher, student, user} and falls back to user. Fix is either (a) backend seed update to set role='student' for student accounts, or (b) frontend mapping to treat the default authenticated non-admin as STUDENT. Reproduction: login as student1@swu.ac.th, inspect .utb-role-badge text — it reads 'USER'.
